entities.name: Royal Crusade
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Royal Crusade, a transformative movement in Cambodia (1940–1953). Emerged from Geneva Accord and French impose a convention stripping the king of most remaining powers. Catalyzed Sihanouk and King Norodom Sihanouk achieves full independence through his 'Royal Crusade'.
